title: Background drain waits for the outstanding VFS_RESYNC and parks

preconditions.notes: An appended write at mseq 2 has an outstanding VFS_RESYNC; the Worker is still connected and answers with a complete write before the 20 s deadline.

timeline.detail: admission closes and the 20 s timer starts; the drain waits for the outstanding VFS_RESYNC at /dsh/workspace/notes.txt mseq 2

timeline.event: the Worker answers VFS_RESYNC with a complete write at the next mseq
timeline.detail: the repair write settles the held append and the watermark advances; no VFS_CONFLICT is needed
materialized copy fsynced, epoch-close record appended, segments and manifest made durable, then VFS_ACK level 2 (wal.md section 5.2)

notes: The new assertion is the wait itself: the drain may not close the epoch while the connected Worker is answering an already-issued VFS_RESYNC. The terminal Parked/closed_epoch shape is the existing D14 row; the repair is settled under wal.md section 5.1/6.2. A runner that closes immediately would observe Failed and fail this fixture.
